summary: The current v0.2 text fixes both Round 1 MAJOR findings. In Approach D, the line ~97 region now presents only the negative result: the previously unsupported worst-case reduction formula is no longer asserted as a valid step and is explicitly framed as the missing β.G5 theorem in another form, with the conclusion at lines 97-99 now stating that purification does not yield a fixed-channel amortization theorem. The citation-taxonomy fix is also present: Approach B first mentions `Pirandola 2017` with `[RECALLED]` in the header and again in the idea line, and Approach C first mentions `Kamin 2025 / Metger 2024 GEAT` with `[RECALLED]` in the header and idea line. I did not find any new major issues introduced by these fixes; `[CONJ-DRAFT]` status is maintained, `β.G5 remains OPEN` is stated explicitly, and no cross-space trap was introduced in this document.
